instruction: Remove both Vim and Google Chrome from the dock favorites, keeping only Thunderbird.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully removed vim from dock favorites by right-clicking the Vim icon and selecting 'Remove from Favorites'. Completed in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with GNOME dock, right-click context menus, select 'Remove from Favorites' option
metadata.task_rationale: Harder variation requiring removal of two apps instead of one, testing multi-step dock management within demonstrated capability
metadata.explanation: Task requires removing both Vim and Chrome from dock favorites. Evaluator checks that only thunderbird remains. Reuses official check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

scoring_breakdown.favorites_check: 1.0 - Favorites list contains only thunderbird.desktop after removing vim and chrome

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses gsettings to read current GNOME dock favorites, which is the exact state needed to verify the instruction.
Metric check_gnome_favorite_apps correctly parses the gsettings output string, compares both set equality and length against expected apps list, ensuring exact match.
Expected value ['thunderbird.desktop'] correctly represents the desired final state after removing both Vim and Chrome.
Config correctly sets up initial state with all three apps (thunderbird, vim, chrome) in the dock favorites.
Coverage is complete: the single evaluator check verifies both removals and the retention of Thunderbird in one comparison.
Metric parameter handling is correct: rule parameter receives {'expected': ['thunderbird.desktop']} and accesses rule['expected'] directly.
